care_body: Dust gently with a soft, dry cloth. Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight and moisture. Use protective mats beneath objects on wood surfaces.

about_title: A laser, a sheet, a path.
about_intro: Metal Craft is a laser-cutting workshop. We draw each design as a vector path, cut it from steel or aluminium sheet and finish it before it ships.
about_second: Most pieces are made to order, so each product page lists its own production time.
material_title:
No two grains.
No two stories.
material_body: We cut steel up to 12 mm and aluminium up to 4 mm thick, from sheets up to 1500 × 3000 mm. The material, thickness and finish of each piece are listed on its product page.
not_found_body: The link may be out of date. Browse the collection instead.
oak_intro: Every Metal Craft piece begins with Bulgarian oak over 100 years old. A material with a life before us, and a future with you.
oak_grain_body: Look closely. Tight growth rings reveal the wood’s distinctive, dense grain. We select aged oak for its durability and structural stability, giving every piece substance you can feel.
oak_grain_detail: Its value starts beneath the surface.
oak_patina_title: A colour only time can tell.
oak_patina_body: Over time, oak develops a rich, darkened patina. Variations in tone, grain and texture become a record of a life already lived. This is the warmth and depth we bring into a Metal Craft piece.
oak_patina_detail: Time gives the surface its own depth.
oak_life_title: An old soul. A new home.
oak_life_body: Aged oak can come from reclaimed barn beams or heritage trees. What remains is strong timber with a story worth keeping. Metal Craft shapes this character into furniture for another chapter.
oak_life_caption: Wood, shaped for a new chapter

capacity_body: Every design is cut from a single sheet. These are the limits of our current machine.
process_1_body: Each design is drawn as a closed vector path, with small bridges that hold inner shapes in place.
process_2_body: The laser follows that path through the steel or aluminium sheet.
process_3_body: Edges are cleaned and the piece is painted where the design calls for it.
process_4_body: The finished piece is packed and shipped to you.
faq_1_a: No. They are digital design previews of the finished piece. Every piece is cut to order after you buy it.
faq_2_a: Steel up to 12 mm and aluminium up to 4 mm thick, from sheets up to 1500 × 3000 mm.
faq_3_q: How long does a piece take?
faq_3_a: It depends on the piece. Each product page shows its production time before you add it to your bag.
faq_4_q: What finish do the pieces have?
faq_4_a: Most pieces are shown in matte black. The final material, thickness and finish are confirmed before cutting.
